title: A week of every bus and streetcar in Toronto
description:
A week of every bus and streetcar in Toronto, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Toronto city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Bus, Express and Streetcar, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 1,562 vehicles, Tuesday at 5:10 pm.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Thanksgiving (October 12). October 31 is left out because the clocks change that night. GO Transit ran a reduced timetable on October 10 and 11, so those days are left out. GO Transit changed its timetables during October and has fewer than three usable October Saturdays and Sundays, so its Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday each use one typical date. Durham Region Transit changed its timetables during October, so its Tuesday and Wednesday each use one typical date.
